thought.text: The harness has a flaky podman connection (it sets `container=podman`). The errors are transient. Let me write the test file (separately from execution):

reasoning_content:
The harness is intermittently throwing podman errors. This seems to be an environmental instability (the `container=podman` env var suggests the harness is wrapping commands in a podman-aware manner). The errors are transient — commands succeed when the podman socket is up.

Let me try again to write the full authentication test. This is an important verification (the complete user login flow). I'll write the file first, and then execute it separately.

action.command:
cat > /tmp/full_auth.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
cd /workspace
eval $(grep -E "^(LOCAL_USER_EMAIL|LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD)=" .env | sed 's/^/export /')
JAR=/tmp/full-auth-cookies.txt
OUT=/tmp/full-auth.out
: > $OUT
rm -f "$JAR"
loc=$(curl -sS -c $JAR -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" "http://localhost:3000/app/" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step1-redirect=$loc" >> $OUT
[ -z "$loc" ] && { echo "FAIL no redirect" >> $OUT; cat $OUT; exit 1; }
code=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-login.html -w "%{http_code}" "$loc" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step2-authpage=$code" >> $OUT
ACTION=$(grep -oE '<form id="kc-form-login"[^>]*action="[^"]*"' /tmp/fa-login.html | sed 's/.*action="//;s/"$//;s/&/\&/g')
res=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-login2.html -w "%{http_code}|%{redirect_url}" -X POST "$ACTION" \
  --data-urlencode "username=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" \
  --data-urlencode "password=$LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD" \
  --data-urlencode "signup=false" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step3-login=$res" >> $OUT
CB=$(echo "$res" | cut -d'|' -f2)
echo "callback=$CB" >> $OUT
res4=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}|%{redirect_url}" "$CB" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step4-callback=$res4" >> $OUT
APP=$(echo "$res4" | cut -d'|' -f2)
code5=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-app.html -w "%{http_code}" "$APP" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step5-app=$code5" >> $OUT
echo "app-title=$(grep -oE '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/fa-app.html | head -1)" >> $OUT
echo "=== RESULT ==="
cat $OUT
SCRIPT
echo "file written: $(ls -la /tmp/full_auth.sh | awk '{print $5}') bytes"
